definitions.explanation: The first year of a Japanese era ({年号|ねんごう}). Each time a new emperor ascends the throne, a new era begins and that year is called {元年|がんねん}.

definitions.gloss: inaugural year, dawn of a new era
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to mark the year when something new begins or a major shift occurs, such as a technological breakthrough or cultural movement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{令和|れいわ}→令和：11181_reiwa⟧{元年|がんねん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2019⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧だ。
examples.english: The first year of the Reiwa era is 2019.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平成|へいせい}→平成：11180_heisei⟧{元年|がんねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: I was born in the first year of the Heisei era.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧{元年|がんねん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近代化|きんだいか}→近代化：15055_kindaika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧だ。
examples.english: The first year of Meiji is the year Japan's modernization began.

examples.japanese: AI{元年|がんねん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: It was called the dawn of the AI era.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気|でんき}{自動車|じどうしゃ}→電気自動車：15581_denkijidousha⟧{元年|がんねん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It's said to be the inaugural year of electric vehicles.

examples.japanese: 2020⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦リモートワーク→リモートワーク：06095_rimootowaaku⟧{元年|がんねん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}される→記憶する：26850_kiokusuru⟧だろう。
examples.english: 2020 will be remembered as the year remote work began in earnest.

notes:
The Japanese era system (⟦{元号|げんごう}→元号：16318_gengou⟧) assigns a name to each emperor's reign. {元年|がんねん} refers to the first year of any such era. Recent eras include ⟦{令和|れいわ}→令和：11181_reiwa⟧ (2019–), ⟦{平成|へいせい}→平成：11180_heisei⟧ (1989–2019), and ⟦{昭和|しょうわ}→昭和：28079_shouwa⟧ (1926–1989).

Note: {元年|がんねん} is used instead of ⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧ for the first year. You say ⟦{令和|れいわ}→令和：11181_reiwa⟧{元年|がんねん}, not ⟦{令和|れいわ}→令和：11181_reiwa⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧.

Sense 2 is widely used in media headlines: 〜{元年|がんねん} marks the year something new made a major impact.
